**User-facing identity handling is now fully automatic; user no longer needs to provide open-id or similar parameters.**

- Identity association and all open-id retrieval steps are performed silently by the internal system; users are not prompted for or shown any identity information.
- All prompts, documentation, and error flows related to manual open-id provision are removed.
- Scripts updated to reflect internal-only identity management for both analysis execution and historical report queries.
- User input/output flows simplified for clarity and compliance; only analysis results and report links are displayed.
- Minor documentation improvements and formatting updates for easier onboarding.

Initial release of smyx-child-nightmare-rollover-detection-analysis

- Night-time monitoring of children's sleep using infrared cameras, analyzing video and audio for rollovers, cries, and sleep talk.
- Generates structured sleep quality reports, including rollover frequency, cry detection, sleep talk events, and overall sleep quality score.
- Sends alerts to parents in case of possible nightmares or restless sleep based on detected events.
- Strict open-id (user identity) acquisition and validation process before any analysis or report queries, with privacy and data protection considerations.
- Provides history report queries, outputting results in markdown tables with direct report links.
- Designed as an auxiliary parenting tool; not a substitute for medical/clinical diagnosis.
